description: Authoritative list of the channels on the multi-channel platform. legacy_channel_id links a channel to its entry in channels.json; null means it has none yet. upload.status decides whether a channel may ever upload.

channels.name: AI Tested
channels.editorial: AI tools, features, comparisons and real workflows. Demonstrates what a tool does instead of repeating announcements.
channels.visual: Clean technology journalism on white. Restrained colour. Purple must not dominate.

channels.name: Hidden Past
channels.editorial: Evidence-led history: mysteries, forgotten people and events, investigations. Never manufactures mystery where the record is plain.
channels.visual: VOX-inspired editorial on white or warm archival paper. Archival photographs never move.

channels.name: Red Space Facts
channels.editorial: Planets, astronomy and what-if questions. Separates observations, models, hypotheticals and artistic interpretation.
channels.visual: Cinematic, scientifically grounded space. Explanatory graphics default to white; space scenes use space.

channels.name: Dopamine Loop
channels.editorial: The subjective experience of emotion. Picture the emotion, not just the mind. Never diagnoses the viewer.
channels.visual: Cinematic psychological storytelling; expressive Rive characters where they help. Not a cartoon channel.

upload.reason: No YouTube channel or OAuth secret is on record for this channel.

channels.name: Gray Matter
channels.editorial: What happens inside the brain during everyday experience. Separates correlation from causation.
channels.visual: Scientifically grounded, labelled anatomy and processes. Every structure is named on screen.

upload.reason: No YouTube channel or OAuth secret is on record for this channel.

channels.name: Rival Lines
channels.editorial: Football first. Player documentaries, and match analysis of genuinely significant games with a clear thesis.
channels.visual: Premium sports documentary and tactical broadcast graphics. Never cartoonish.

channels.name: Court & Spotlight
channels.editorial: Celebrity and pop culture in three selectable formats: investigation, entertainment magazine, VOX-style explainer.
channels.visual: Format decides: evidence-panel documentary, glossy magazine, or explanatory graphics.
channels.voice_direction: Follows the format: serious, energetic or analytical.

channels.name: World View
channels.editorial: Serious, neutral geopolitics and political history. Attributes contested interpretations and never treats a group as one political entity.
channels.visual: VOX-inspired visual journalism with realistic maps. Six scene directions.
